scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Ah...
The pinnacle
of craftsmanship.
That's the work of
a MasterSmith.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
啊……
工艺的巅峰。
这就是神工匠的作品。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Once you're the
the best of the best,
you begin forging with
the goal of discovering
new and better ways of
crafting...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
一旦你成为精英中的精英，
你就会开始以发现
更新、更好的锻造方法
为目标进行锻造……

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
The time has come!
Our world needs brave,
hard-working adventurers
like you...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
时机已到！
我们的世界需要像你这样
勇敢、勤奋的冒险者……

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Would you like to
become a MasterSmith?
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你想成为神工匠吗？

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
当你准备好时，
随时欢迎回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回到我这里之前用完所有剩余的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Congratulations!
As a MasterSmith,
I hope you will forge
a path towards a brighter
future for Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜！
作为一名神工匠，
我希望你能为米德加尔特
开创一个更光明的未来。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣耀之厅。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
请在这里
随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！
